merchant_rules_one_shape.name: merchant_rules_one_shape
merchant_rules_one_shape.value:
(
        "merchant_rules"."flat_type" IS NOT NULL AND "merchant_rules"."threshold" IS NULL
          AND "merchant_rules"."at_or_above_type" IS NULL AND "merchant_rules"."below_type" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "merchant_rules"."flat_type" IS NULL AND "merchant_rules"."threshold" IS NOT NULL
          AND "merchant_rules"."at_or_above_type" IS NOT NULL AND "merchant_rules"."below_type" IS NOT NULL
      )

merchant_rules_types_valid.name: merchant_rules_types_valid
merchant_rules_types_valid.value:
("merchant_rules"."flat_type" IS NULL OR "merchant_rules"."flat_type" IN ('Fixed', 'Necessary', 'Nice to have', ''))
        AND ("merchant_rules"."at_or_above_type" IS NULL OR "merchant_rules"."at_or_above_type" IN ('Fixed', 'Necessary', 'Nice to have', ''))
        AND ("merchant_rules"."below_type" IS NULL OR "merchant_rules"."below_type" IN ('Fixed', 'Necessary', 'Nice to have', ''))

transactions_expense_type_valid.name: transactions_expense_type_valid
transactions_expense_type_valid.value: "transactions"."expense_type" IS NULL OR "transactions"."expense_type" IN ('Fixed', 'Necessary', 'Nice to have', '')

transactions_source_provenance.name: transactions_source_provenance
transactions_source_provenance.value:
("transactions"."source" = 'csv' AND "transactions"."upload_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."external_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."source_row" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("transactions"."source" = 'bank_sync' AND "transactions"."upload_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."source_row" IS NULL)
